ruleDefinitions.name: Compressed File Creation Via Tar.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects execution of "tar.exe" in order to create a compressed file.
Adversaries may abuse various utilities to compress or encrypt data before exfiltration.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\tar\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bsdtar") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-r.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-u.*")))
